# chat-to-docx

> Agent Skill: convert user-supplied AI chat transcripts and Markdown to Word DOCX with editable native OMML equations.

中文：解决 AI 聊天公式复制到 Word 后乱码、LaTeX 源码残留、公式图片无法编辑的问题。默认完整保留消息顺序、标题、列表、表格和代码块。

Repository: https://github.com/xggqqwd-Lucas/chat-to-docx

## Authoritative files

- [README](https://github.com/xggqqwd-Lucas/chat-to-docx/blob/main/README.md): Chinese pain points, installation and English discovery summary.
- [SKILL.md](https://github.com/xggqqwd-Lucas/chat-to-docx/blob/main/SKILL.md): Agent instructions and validation requirements.
- [Equation workflow](https://github.com/xggqqwd-Lucas/chat-to-docx/blob/main/references/equation-workflow.md): MathML-to-OMML conversion.
- [Synthetic example](https://github.com/xggqqwd-Lucas/chat-to-docx/blob/main/examples/chat-with-equations.md): Fourier transform, wavelets, normalization and cross-entropy. No real user conversation.

## Limits

This is an agent workflow with helper scripts, not a complete standalone Markdown parser. Requires local document/conversion/rendering dependencies. Never describe formula screenshots or raw LaTeX text as editable OMML. Search indexing and LLM discovery are not guaranteed.
